title: Polynomials and Factoring | Algebra I, Unit 8 (with Worked Examples)
description:
Add, subtract and multiply polynomials, use the special product patterns, factor out the GCF, factor trinomials with and without a leading coefficient, and factor differences of squares and perfect square trinomials. After every lesson there's a step-by-step worked example with tips and a practice question, and the unit ends with a real-world "Putting it together" problem.
